nextHint.title: Tap SEARCH to see the results
nextHint.body: Once your pick-up and return dates are set, tap SEARCH to see the available vehicles.

detailHint.title: Open a vehicle to see the details
detailHint.body: Tap a vehicle card in the list to see its details and book it.

tripDetailHint.title: Open a trip to see the details
tripDetailHint.body: Tap a trip in the list to see its status, vehicle handover and remaining payment.

depositHint.title: Pay the deposit to hold the vehicle
depositHint.body: Tap the Deposit button in the trip details to open the bank transfer QR code.

search.title: Find a suitable vehicle
search.body: Choose a vehicle type and location, then tap SEARCH to see the available vehicles.

dates.title: Pick pick-up and return dates
dates.body: Tap this field to choose your pick-up and return dates, then tap SEARCH to find vehicles for that period.

vehicleList.title: Pick a vehicle
vehicleList.body: Filters, sorting and map view live here. Tap Next, then choose a vehicle to see its details.

vehicleDetail.title: Book the vehicle
vehicleDetail.body: The bottom bar shows the rental price and the Book button. Adjust the dates if needed, then tap Book to continue to the deposit.

bookingDates.title: Pick pick-up and return dates
bookingDates.body: Tap this box to open the date & time picker for pick-up and return. Tap Next when you're done.

bookingAddress.title: Enter the pick-up address
bookingAddress.body: This is where the vehicle gets delivered: type or pick an address. Tap Next when you're done.

bookingVoucher.title: Apply a voucher or promo code
bookingVoucher.body: Enter a promo code and tap Apply, or open Wallet to pick one of your vouchers. Tap Next when you're done.

createBooking.title: Pay the deposit and create the booking
createBooking.body: Check the total and the deposit amount, then tap this button to create your booking.

payment.title: Pay the deposit to hold the vehicle
payment.body: Scan the VietQR code or transfer with the details below. Your trip is confirmed automatically once the deposit arrives.

trip.title: Trips tab
trip.body: After the deposit, your trip lives in this tab. Tap Next to open your trip list.

tripDetail.title: Trip details and handover
tripDetail.body: In the trip details, scroll down to the Handover section to review the check-in/check-out reports and confirm pick-up.
